retrieval_cases.query: How do we prevent duplicate charges when a payment is retried?

candidates.title: Retry log colour
candidates.body: The console highlights payment retry attempts in blue.

candidates.title: Idempotent settlement
candidates.body: Use a stable idempotency key for each purchase so repeated settlement requests create one charge.

candidates.title: Receipt typography
candidates.body: Payment receipts use a larger font.

candidates.title: Gateway duplicate prevention
candidates.body: Gateway requests retain the original operation key through retries; the second response reuses the first transaction.

retrieval_cases.reason: Both implementation notes answer the paraphrase; lexical decorations do not.
